title: Aspire Gotek Replacement Pods - 2 Pack
description: The Aspire Gotek-X and Gotek Pro are a truly unique vape kit designed for ease of use, portability and immensely satisfying and flavoursome MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with the option to enjoy RDTL (restricted-direct-to-lung) vaping with the aid of an adjustable airflow control. The Aspire Gotek replacement pods can contain 2ml of your favourite e-liquid and can be refilled simply and cleanly using the side-fill port. The pod contains an integrated 0.8ohm AF mesh coil or 0.6ohm AF mesh coil ( Only Compatible with the Gotek Pro Kit ) that delivers exceptional flavour with the Aspire Gotek X’s max power output of 13W. The Aspire Gotek X pods are perfect for use with nic salt , 50/50 and classic High-PG e-liquids. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
